review.draftParagraph: Three weather stations within 12 km recorded gusts of 54-61 mph during Storm Bram, meeting the policy threshold. Ridge tile displacement is damage a storm causes. The adjuster relied on mean wind (38 mph) rather than gusts and provided no dated photographs showing the mortar had already failed before the storm. Under stage 2 of the burden of proof, the insurer must prove a gradual-cause exclusion applies; that has not been done here.
